examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The blog post closing band: the `start` heading over three related posts, each with its cover. A band with no items renders nothing, and one with no title drops its header. Azion UI ships no editorial media, so the covers here are the neutral `@aziontech/ui/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.

examples.name: Alignments
examples.summary: Both placements stacked: the `start` heading over three covers, then the `center` heading under an overline over three cards that draw their client marks. Azion UI ships no editorial media, so the covers here are the neutral `@aziontech/ui/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.
